phase3_findings.description: docs/external/docs/configuration/providers.md field table stale (auth 'bearer or api_key', base_url required) vs shipped 3-value enum + conditional base_url.
docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md resolver description stale (base_url required, auth bearer|api_key, no bedrock path).
Hoisted API_TIMEOUT_MS write not exercised on the bedrock arm (all fixtures TIMEOUT_MS=''); a regression re-nesting it in the else branch would silently drop it on bedrock.
Whitespace-only AWS_REGION passes the region guard (non-empty string). Narrow edge; author-typed whitespace.

fix_decisions.claim_text: external providers doc stale for bedrock
fix_decisions.evidence: Documentation deliverable owned by implement Phase 4.1 (the prflow:docs pass), tracked by acceptance criterion 17. The review-and-fix loop reviews code and does not author docs; Phase 4.1 writes the external providers.md bedrock entry and Phase 3.4 defers the doc-AC to it.

parking_evidence.basis: docs are authored by implement Phase 4.1, not by the review-and-fix code loop; tracked by AC 17
parking_evidence.failing_input: a consumer reading providers.md is told bedrock_api_key is invalid until Phase 4.1 updates it

fix_decisions.claim_text: internal system overview resolver description stale
fix_decisions.evidence: Documentation deliverable owned by implement Phase 4.1 (the prflow:docs pass), in the issue's Documentation Needed list. Phase 4.1 updates the §17 provider description.

parking_evidence.basis: docs authored by implement Phase 4.1; in the Documentation Needed list
parking_evidence.failing_input: the §17 resolver description misstates the two- vs three-value contract until Phase 4.1

fix_decisions.evidence: A non-empty all-whitespace region is a narrow author-typed edge, the same class as any syntactically-invalid-but-non-empty region string; not gated. The runtime still authenticates then fails at model-call time, no worse than any bad region value. Out of scope for the AC set; surfaced for the human.

parking_evidence.basis: narrow edge (author-typed whitespace), same class as any invalid non-empty region; not in the AC set
parking_evidence.failing_input: AWS_REGION set to a whitespace-only string
